terminals.name: spiral
terminals.command: export DISPLAY=:1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1; exec dbus-run-session -- npm run tauri dev
terminals.description: Spiral Tauri dev app: Vite on http://localhost:1420 plus the native WebKitGTK window on DISPLAY :1. The first launch compiles the Rust backend and can take several minutes; the window appears once the build finishes.
